means.example-sentence: He thought he lost face by asking a silly question in public.
means.sentence-jp: 彼は人前でばかな質問をして面目を失ったと思った。

cloze.maskedText: He thought he ____ by asking a silly question in public.
choices: had a good command of English

notes: 反対表現は save (one’s) face「面目を保つ」。いずれも one's は付けないのが普通。
